name: lifemate
description: LifeMate: integrated daily life management app (Expo + Express + MongoDB)

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix mobile install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,app -c green,cyan --handle-input --default-input-target app "npm --prefix server run dev:memory" "npm --prefix mobile start"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev:memory" "npm --prefix mobile run web"
scripts.dev:atlas: concurrently -n api,app -c green,cyan --handle-input --default-input-target app "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix mobile start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix mobile test
scripts.check: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run lint && npm test
scripts.build:apk: cd mobile && npx eas-cli@latest build -p android --profile preview
